name: Zillertal
beschreibung: The Zillertal stretches for about 50 kilometers in the north of the Alpen. The holiday apartments are spread across the towns of Mayrhofen, Zell am Ziller and the surrounding area. The region offers access to hiking trails and ski areas. Guests will find apartment accommodations with a kitchen, often with a balcony and a view of the mountain landscape. The infrastructure includes local shops and dining.
